what: `.panel` is a grid with an implicit `auto` column, so any unbreakable inline code in a caption or bubble widens the track beyond the panel, and `.panel { overflow: hidden }` then clips every child (code, terminals, cards) with no scroll and no page-overflow signal. Seen in py ch26 P17, P18, P32. The checker can't see it because document scrollWidth stays at 390.
evidence: py ch26 P17: track 369.5px in a 358px panel (scrollWidth 406). The audit.js 'beyond' list is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-py-26-27/a26/audit.json. Any chapter with long <code> in captions is likely affected.
fix: Before: `.panel { display: grid; ... }` (implicit auto track) -> After: `.panel { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) }` plus `:is(.caption, .bubble) :is(code, samp) { overflow-wrap: break-word }` (why: a minmax(0,1fr) track can't grow past the panel, and break-word only breaks a token when it would overflow). Also add a checker test: fail when any visible panel child's right edge passes the panel's by more than 2px.

what: The dial needle's transition is dead code. Every button press calls L.drawCast, which replaces the SVG's innerHTML, so the needle is a new element each time and `transition: transform 0.4s ease` never plays. If it did play, it would break the motion budget (400ms, built-in ease).
evidence: py-ch26.css: `.ch26-needle { transition: transform 0.4s ease; }` plus two local off-switches. py-ch26.js show(): `art.setAttribute("data-label", d); L.drawCast(art.parentNode)`. comic.js:253: `els[i].innerHTML = c.draw(els[i])`.
fix: Before: `.ch26-needle { transition: transform 0.4s ease }` plus local reduced/motion-off rules -> After: delete all three rules (remedy 1), or keep one needle element and set its transform with `transition: transform var(--dur-move) var(--ease-in-out)` (why: the needle never animates today; if it should, 280ms with the strong in-out curve is the budget, and the engine already switches transitions off).
